items.title: Construction
items.description:
Gain practical skills and industry knowledge for construction-related work in Japan, including tool handling, site safety, and hands-on techniques used on real job sites.

Duration: 6 weeks — Rs. 14,000

items.title: Agriculture
items.description:
Develop essential agricultural skills and knowledge to prepare for greenhouse operations, crop handling, and the machinery commonly used in Japan's farming sector.

Duration: 6 weeks — Rs. 12,000

items.title: Food Service
items.description:
Learn essential food service skills, workplace practices, and hygiene knowledge required to work confidently in Japan's restaurant and hospitality industry.

Duration: 4 weeks — Rs. 10,000

items.title: Aviation Ground Handling
items.description:
Build practical knowledge and skills for airport ground operations, including baggage handling, safety procedures, and coordination with flight crews.

Duration: 6 weeks — Rs. 15,000

items.title: Nursing Caregiver
items.description:
Develop the essential knowledge, skills, and care practices needed to support elderly and dependent individuals in Japan's caregiving facilities.

Duration: 2 months — Rs. 18,000

items.title: JLPT N5 Preparation
items.description:
Build your Japanese language foundation with beginner-level grammar, vocabulary, and conversation skills required for the JLPT N5 exam.

Duration: 3 months — Rs. 12,000
